title: int:ClearingResult
description: Result of a market clearing event for a single market slot. One-to-one with Market.

marketId.description: FK to cleared Market. Primary key. IRI: int:marketId. UUID v4.

clearingStatus.description: EMS outcome status for this clearing event. IRI: int:clearingStatus.

noBidReason.description: Reason code when clearingStatus is NO_BID or REJECTED. IRI: int:noBidReason. Nullable.

clearingPrice.description: Clearing price in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:clearingPrice. Unit: EUR/kWh.

totalSupply.description: Aggregate supply in kWh at clearing time. IRI: int:totalSupply. Unit: kWh.

totalDemand.description: Aggregate demand in kWh at clearing time. IRI: int:totalDemand. Unit: kWh.

tradedQuantity.description: Actual traded volume = min(totalSupply, totalDemand) in kWh. IRI: int:tradedQuantity. Unit: kWh.

numTrades.description: Number of trades generated by this clearing event. IRI: int:numTrades.

txHash.description: Energy Web Chain transaction hash anchoring this result on-chain. IRI: int:txHash.

createdAt.description: Datetime when clearing result was recorded. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
